DSRPSC.description: PSC Rating Code (DSRPSC). A singleton database (key fixed to 1) that selects the PSC load-rating design code; the handler hard-restricts DGNCODE to "AASHTO-LRFR19".

DGNCODE.description: PSC Rating Code. Currently this API only accepts "AASHTO-LRFR19"; any other value is rejected (LV_WRONG_FIELD).
